flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: workflows/datahiveuenfin (DataHiveUenFinService.storeUenDataResult, updateShareholderInfo), services/datahive/nricFinUenDataRetrieval/service/DataHiveUENBatchService, cron-schedules-prod.properties. ocmsadminui pages/Vault/Datahive (Directors Details with empty data). ocmsadminapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no code specific to this story
note: 3-point story, status 'Requirement given - Gen flow' (not verified). Only the receipt of ACRA data from DataHive (board and shareholders) through DataHiveUenFinJob exists; board data is not stored (OCMS-DEV-2026-231), there is no date-of-offence / appointment-period filter, and no code decides to revert to RD1 (Director/Partner) or RD2 (Owner/Partner). The UEN job is off in prod (cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false). The name 'DOS' is not in code: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. Only data receipt exists (partly); the date filter and the revert decision are not built. Confirm the decision rule with URA.

steps.step: OCMS receives the owner/partner/director particulars from DOS
steps.detail: Same as OCMS12.12 step 4: the DataHive result carries shareholderData and boardData (BATCH:196-210). Shareholders are saved (SVC:1442-1448) without appointment dates; board data is only logged and not written to the DB (OCMS-DEV-2026-231, SVC:1468-1478). The UEN job is off in prod (cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false, cron-schedules-prod.properties:52). The name 'DOS' is not in code: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The received particulars are stored in OCMS so the decision can use them
steps.detail: Shareholders are written to ocms_dh_acra_shareholder_info (person id, share allotted, category) without name or appointment date; board data is NOT written (SVC:1468-1478, OCMS-DEV-2026-231). The staff portal has a 'Directors Details' tab but it is called with data={{}} (DatahiveHirerDetail.tsx:57-59, DirectorDetail.tsx:19-28), so officers do not see directors from the DB.

steps.step: Particulars are selected based on the date of offence
steps.detail: The board query is only WHERE ENTITY_UEN IN (...) (BATCH:436-442) and the notice query (SVC:221-246) does not carry the offence date for UEN; no code compares the offence date with ACRA data. Grep tried: offence date, appointment, director, partner, position in ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminapi, thirdpartyapi.

steps.step: Particulars are selected based on the appointment period
steps.detail: position_appointment_date and position_withdrawn_date are carried in BoardInfo (BATCH:196-210) but never compared with any date; board data is not even written to the DB (SVC:1468-1478). There is no appointment-period check.

steps.step: OCMS decides to revert the notice to send the 1st reminder to the individual Director/Partner
steps.detail: No code changes next_processing_stage from the UEN lookup result: DataHiveUenFinService only writes company name, address, shareholders and applies TS-ACR suspensions (de-registered, UEN not found, mandatory data missing) (SVC:1346-1480); next_processing_stage is only read (SVC:226, 310). There is no Director/Partner decision branch. Manual alternative: officers can furnish a hirer through the staff portal (outside the automatic flow of this story).

steps.step: OCMS decides to revert the notice to send the 2nd reminder to the individual Owner/Partner
steps.detail: No code changes next_processing_stage from the UEN lookup result: DataHiveUenFinService only writes company name, address, shareholders and applies TS-ACR suspensions (de-registered, UEN not found, mandatory data missing) (SVC:1346-1480); next_processing_stage is only read (SVC:226, 310). There is no Owner/Partner decision branch.
